title: Remove 'Today', 'This Week', and 'Current Streak' from Fasting Evaluation Section

requirements.text: In the IntermittentFastingPanel component, remove the three evaluation/metrics display items: 'Heute' (Today), 'Diese Woche' (This Week), and 'Aktuelle Serie' (Current Streak) from the fasting summary/evaluation section. The rest of the panel (live countdown timer, progress bar, fasting phase indicator, and FastingScheduleSettings) must remain intact.

quotes: Dashboard Fasten: Auswertung - Heute, Diese Woche, Aktuelle Serie entfernen.

acceptanceCriteria: The 'Heute' (Today) metric is no longer rendered in the IntermittentFastingPanel.
The 'Diese Woche' (This Week) metric is no longer rendered in the IntermittentFastingPanel.
The 'Aktuelle Serie' (Current Streak) metric is no longer rendered in the IntermittentFastingPanel.
The countdown timer, progress bar, fasting phase label, and schedule settings remain visible and functional.
No visual layout breaks or empty placeholder spaces remain where the removed items were.

constraints: Do not remove or alter the countdown timer, progress bar, fasting phase indicator, or FastingScheduleSettings.
Do not modify any backend files.
Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
nonGoals: Removing any other sections of the fasting panel.
Changes to other dashboard panels (Nutrition, Sleep, Movement, Stress).
